query.statement: SELECT PLAN_ID, PLAN_NAME, PLANT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, PLANNED_QTY, PLANNED_START_DATE, PLANNED_END_DATE, STATUS, REMARK FROM POM_PRODUCTION_PLAN WHERE PLANT_ID = @plantId AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY PLANNED_START_DATE
SELECT STATUS, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM POM_PRODUCTION_PLAN WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) GROUP BY STATUS ORDER BY STATUS

SELECT ORDER_ID, PLAN_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, ORDER_QTY, ACTUAL_QTY, SCHEDULED_START, SCHEDULED_END, ACTUAL_START, ACTUAL_END, STATUS FROM POM_PRODUCTION_ORDER WHERE PLAN_ID = @planId AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY SCHEDULED_START

SELECT ORDER_ID, PLAN_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, ORDER_QTY, ACTUAL_QTY, SCHEDULED_START, SCHEDULED_END, ACTUAL_START, ACTUAL_END, STATUS FROM POM_PRODUCTION_ORDER WHERE EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY SCHEDULED_START DESC

SELECT LOT_ID, PLANT_ID, WORK_ORDER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, QTY, DEFECT_QTY, LOT_STATE, PROCESS_STATE, ROUTE_STEPS, CURRENT_STEP, EQUIPMENT_ID, RECIPE_DEF_ID, RECIPE_DEF_VERSION, CARRIER_ID, IS_HOLD FROM POM_LOT WHERE PLANT_ID = @plantId AND (@lotState IS NULL OR LOT_STATE = @lotState) ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT LOT_ID, PLANT_ID, WORK_ORDER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, QTY, DEFECT_QTY, LOT_STATE, PROCESS_STATE, ROUTE_STEPS, CURRENT_STEP, EQUIPMENT_ID, RECIPE_DEF_ID, RECIPE_DEF_VERSION, CARRIER_ID, IS_HOLD FROM POM_LOT WHERE WORK_ORDER_ID = @workOrderId ORDER BY LOT_ID

SELECT LOT_HISTORY_ID, PLANT_ID, LOT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, PROCESS_ID, RECIPE_DEF_ID, RECIPE_DEF_VERSION, TRACK_IN_TIME, TRACK_OUT_TIME, EXECUTION_ID, EXECUTION_USER, QTY, DEFECT_QTY, LOT_STATE, PROCESS_STATE, CREATED_AT FROM POM_LOT_HISTORY WHERE PLANT_ID = @plantId AND LOT_ID = @lotId ORDER BY LOT_HISTORY_ID

SELECT ORDER_ID, PLAN_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, ORDER_QTY, ACTUAL_QTY, SCHEDULED_START, SCHEDULED_END, ACTUAL_START, ACTUAL_END, STATUS FROM POM_PRODUCTION_ORDER WHERE (@planId IS NULL OR PLAN_ID = @planId) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY SCHEDULED_START DESC

SELECT LOT_ID, PLANT_ID, WORK_ORDER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, QTY, DEFECT_QTY, LOT_STATE, PROCESS_STATE, CURRENT_STEP, EQUIPMENT_ID, IS_HOLD FROM POM_LOT WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@lotState IS NULL OR LOT_STATE = @lotState) AND (@isHold IS NULL OR IS_HOLD = @isHold) ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT LOT_ID, PLANT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, QTY, LOT_STATE, PROCESS_STATE, EQUIPMENT_ID, IS_HOLD FROM POM_LOT WHERE IS_HOLD = 'Y' ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT LOT_ID, PLANT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, QTY, DEFECT_QTY, LOT_STATE, EQUIPMENT_ID FROM POM_LOT WHERE DEFECT_QTY > 0 ORDER BY DEFECT_QTY DESC
SELECT PRODUCT_ID, COUNT(*) AS LOT_COUNT, SUM(QTY) AS TOTAL_QTY, SUM(DEFECT_QTY) AS DEFECT_QTY, SUM(QTY) - SUM(DEFECT_QTY) AS GOOD_QTY FROM POM_LOT GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID ORDER BY TOTAL_QTY DESC

SELECT WORK_ORDER_ID, PLANT_ID, WORK_ORDER_NAME, PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, WORK_ORDER_TYPE, PRODUCT_ID, PLAN_START_DATE, PLAN_END_DATE, PLAN_QTY, START_QTY, COMPLETE_QTY, SCRAP_QTY, STATUS, IS_HOLD FROM POM_WORK_ORDER WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY PLAN_START_DATE DESC

SELECT LOT_HISTORY_ID, PLANT_ID, LOT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, PROCESS_ID, TRACK_IN_TIME, TRACK_OUT_TIME, EXECUTION_ID, EXECUTION_USER, QTY, DEFECT_QTY, LOT_STATE, PROCESS_STATE FROM POM_LOT_HISTORY WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@lotId IS NULL OR LOT_ID = @lotId) ORDER BY LOT_HISTORY_ID DESC LIMIT 500
